param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$JobRequest
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function UtcNowId {
  return ([DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ'))
}

$repo = (Get-Location).Path
$run_id = (UtcNowId) + '_' + ([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,8))

$runs_dir = Join-Path $repo 'args\data\runs'
$run_dir = Join-Path $runs_dir $run_id
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $run_dir | Out-Null

Copy-Item -Force $JobRequest (Join-Path $run_dir 'job_request.json')

$val = & py -3.11 -m args.foundry.job_request_v0 --in (Join-Path $run_dir 'job_request.json')
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
  $val
  exit $LASTEXITCODE
}

$jr = Get-Content (Join-Path $run_dir 'job_request.json') -Raw
$prompt = @()
$prompt += 'ROLE: ChatGPT as codegen tool'
$prompt += 'OUTPUT MUST BE A SINGLE JSON OBJECT, schema=codegen_patch_v0'
$prompt += 'ONLY allowed op: write_file'
$prompt += 'All paths are relative to workspace root. No absolute paths. No .. traversal. No secrets.'
$prompt += ''
$prompt += 'JOB_REQUEST_JSON:'
$prompt += $jr
$prompt += ''
$prompt += 'TARGET TEMPLATE FILES (workspace root):'
$prompt += ' - src/main.py'
$prompt += ' - src/cli.py'
$prompt += ' - config.example.json'
$prompt += ' - tests/test_smoke.py'
$prompt += ''
$prompt += 'RESPONSE FORMAT:'
$prompt += '{"schema":"codegen_patch_v0","ops":[{"op":"write_file","path":"src/main.py","encoding":"utf-8","content":"..."}]}'

$prompt_path = Join-Path $run_dir 'prompt_pack.txt'
$prompt -join "`n" | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $prompt_path

$out = [ordered]@{
  schema = 'factory_prompt_v1'
  ok = $true
  exit_code = 0
  run_id = $run_id
  run_dir = $run_dir
  prompt_path = $prompt_path
  next_step = 'Place ChatGPT response JSON into runs/<run_id>/codegen_output.json, then run run_factory_app_build_release_v1.ps1 -RunId <run_id>'
}
$out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress
exit 0

param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$RunId,
  [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)][string]$Repo = (Get-Location).Path
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

if (-not $RunId -or $RunId.Trim().Length -lt 5) {
  throw 'RunId is required (use the run_id returned by run_factory_app_prompt_v1.ps1)'
}

$run_dir = Join-Path (Join-Path $Repo 'args\data\runs') $RunId
if (-not (Test-Path $run_dir)) { throw "run_dir not found: $run_dir" }

$jr_path = Join-Path $run_dir 'job_request.json'
$codegen_path = Join-Path $run_dir 'codegen_output.json'
if (-not (Test-Path $jr_path)) { throw "job_request.json missing in run_dir" }
if (-not (Test-Path $codegen_path)) { throw "codegen_output.json missing in run_dir" }

$jr = Get-Content $jr_path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$product_id = $jr.product_id

# 1) Apply patch into workspace
$apply = & py -3.11 -m args.foundry.workspace_apply_patch_v0 --product-id $product_id --run-id $RunId --codegen $codegen_path
$apply | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $run_dir 'patch_report.json')
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $apply; exit $LASTEXITCODE }

$apply_obj = $apply | ConvertFrom-Json
$ws = $apply_obj.workspace

# 2) Gate workspace
$gate = & py -3.11 -m args.foundry.workspace_gate_v0 --workspace $ws
$gate | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $run_dir 'workspace_gate.json')
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $gate; exit $LASTEXITCODE }

# 3) Build EXE via temp manifest/template based on workspace
$temp_pid = ($product_id + '__ws__' + $RunId)
$temp_template = Join-Path $Repo ("templates\\" + $temp_pid)
if (Test-Path $temp_template) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $temp_template }
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force $ws $temp_template

$temp_manifest = Join-Path $Repo ("manifests\\products\\" + $temp_pid + '.json')
$base_manifest = Join-Path $Repo ("manifests\\products\\" + $product_id + '.json')
$bm = Get-Content $base_manifest -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$bm.product_id = $temp_pid
$bm.template_dir = ("templates/" + $temp_pid)
$bm | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $temp_manifest

$out_dir = Join-Path $Repo ("dist\\" + $product_id)
$build = & py -3.11 -m args.foundry.build_exe_v0 --product-id $temp_pid --out-dir $out_dir
$build | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $run_dir 'build_exe.json')
$build_rc = $LASTEXITCODE

# Cleanup temp manifest + template (best-effort)
try { Remove-Item -Force $temp_manifest } catch {}
try { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $temp_template } catch {}

if ($build_rc -ne 0) { $build; exit $build_rc }

# 4) Release pack
$rel = & py -3.11 -m args.foundry.release_pack_v0 --product-id $product_id
$rel | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $run_dir 'release_pack.json')
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $rel; exit $LASTEXITCODE }

$rel_obj = $rel | ConvertFrom-Json
$rid = $rel_obj.release_id

# 5) Verify release
$ver = & py -3.11 -m args.foundry.release_verify_v0 --release-id $rid
$ver | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $run_dir 'release_verify.json')
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $ver; exit $LASTEXITCODE }

# 6) Final report
$final = [ordered]@{
  schema = 'factory_final_report_v1'
  ok = $true
  exit_code = 0
  run_id = $RunId
  product_id = $product_id
  run_dir = $run_dir
  release_id = $rid
  release_zip = $rel_obj.release_zip
  release_hashes = $rel_obj.release_hashes
}
$final | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $run_dir 'final_report.json')
$final | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress
exit 0
